title: Core Awakening
tagline: Rebuild your identity from the wreckage.
pitch: As the core of a fallen Titan AI, players control a modular mech to dismantle enemies and recover components. Each battle offers tactical choices that shape your mech's abilities and identity.
coreLoop: Players read enemy attack patterns, evade or interrupt them, target critical subsystems, and choose how to salvage components for their mech.

mechanics.name: Evade and Interrupt
mechanics.description: Players must dodge enemy attacks and can interrupt them to gain a strategic advantage.

mechanics.name: Subsystem Targeting
mechanics.description: Players can target and destroy specific enemy subsystems, altering the battle and salvaged loot.

mechanics.name: Component Decision-Making
mechanics.description: After defeating an enemy, players choose to install, secure, or dismantle the component for immediate benefits.

controls.keyboard: WASD for movement, SPACE for interrupt actions, SHIFT to target subsystems
controls.mouse: Aim with the mouse to target subsystems, click to attack

artDirection.backgroundFx: silhouettes of large machinery subtly moving in the background

audioDirection.musicMood: tense and mechanical, building with action

difficulty.start: Very easy, with clear enemy attack patterns and slow-paced actions.
difficulty.progression: Gradually introduces faster enemies and more complex attack patterns.
difficulty.peak: Challenging decisions on component salvage while managing multiple threats.

winLose.win: Defeat the enemy and make a successful component decision.
winLose.lose: The mech's integrity drops to zero.

juice.hitStop: when an attack is successfully interrupted
juice.flash: when a subsystem is hit or a critical moment in combat occurs

scopeNotes: Do not include procedural dungeons, multiple enemy types, bosses, inventory management, crafting, narrative scenes, or save systems.

scoreEvents: score increases when an enemy is defeated, when components are salvaged, and when decisions are made
